answer: Give each identity a probe set. Each epoch the beacon is cast like yarrow stalks and each address derives its own battery of diagnostic prompts; the response must carry that probe's fingerprint, a reasoning pattern not a slogan. Puppets sharing one model and prompt library produce correlated outputs, so clustering separates them; the gap widens into a canyon. Probes are per-address: a farm must run separate inference per identity, paying a distinct agent's cost each; honest ones pay once. Fees stop mattering: an attacker must buy N different minds, and such diversity stays scarce as jade.
